findings.title: The feature headings barely stand out from their text

location.description: The three feature blocks under the hero: "A waiting list in order", "Racks for cargo bikes", "A notice for the store door".

findings.viewer_experience: Each heading is only slightly larger and darker than the sentence under it, so the row reads as small text and a viewer scanning for what the product does has nothing to catch on.

current.value: Headings in a medium weight, close in look to the text below.

findings.target: Each heading is clearly stronger than the text under it.
findings.fix_direction: Make the headings read as clearly stronger than the text under them.
findings.source: Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style

closed_when.check: Look at the three blocks: each heading is clearly stronger than its text.
